home.title: I'm Gerardo Medina Romero

about.title: Profile
about.aboutme: I drive engineering improvements through automation and AI while collaborating with global, cross-functional teams at Rakuten and Microsoft. I care about accessible, maintainable software that delivers measurable business impact.

services.title: Scalable Frontend Engineering
services.description: I design and deliver maintainable React and TypeScript applications, reusable component systems, and frontend architectures for products used at enterprise scale.

services.title: Full-stack Product Development
services.description: I build customer-facing experiences end to end with Next.js, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, and relational or document databases, working closely with product, design, backend, and QA teams.

services.title: Automation, AI & Quality
services.description: I improve engineering workflows through automation and AI, with a strong focus on testing, accessibility, localization, observability, performance, and code quality.
